items.statement: Group confident of exceeding Rs 550 crore sales this year, possibly better.
items.quote: the group is now poised to exceed about 550 crores of sales this year. We may even do better than that.

items.statement: TPMS opportunity with Bosch, Conti, Sensata could be Rs 100-150 crore annually; 5-year order book over Rs 500 crore.
items.quote: if I take a five year picture, right, I would say that the order book would be in the order of magnitude of 500 core plus, right, or a five year period.

items.statement: Expects to keep pushing EBITDA margin higher each quarter going forward.
items.quote: we do expect that going forward, we would continue to build on that and we'll be continuing to push that EBITDA margin higher and higher with each passing quarter, right.

items.statement: Sales mix shifting toward higher-EBITDA products; further improvement expected in Q4, Q1 and next FY.
items.period: Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27, next financial year
items.quote: we do believe going into Q4 and Q1 as well into the next financial year, we would be seeing further improvements on this number, right.

items.statement: Pushing customers for price corrections on non-RM costs like manpower, consumables, power not compensated for long.
items.quote: We are pushing the customers now to get those you know price corrections through for us.

items.statement: Need to allocate capital for new initiatives, metals vertical growth, and TPMS product line for global customers.
items.quote: we need to allocate funds for our new initiative and we need to ensure that, you know, we fund the growth for the metals vertical, for the TPMS product line that we are setting up now for some of our global customers.

items.statement: TPMS mass production for Aumovio and Sensata expected in next six to nine months; Bosch already in mass production.
items.quote: we will go into mass production for continently anywhere in the next I would say six to nine months, we will go into mass production for Aumovio as well.

items.statement: Tube-to-tubeless transition to complete in 4-5 years; Triton better positioned with higher margins in tubeless.
items.quote: over the next maybe four or five years that transition will happen almost completely where you know tube will almost become insignificant and tubeless will be the product that will rule the market, right.

items.statement: Metals vertical developing special alloys; orders received, expect orders to increase in Q4 and Q1.
items.quote: We've already received orders for some of these you know alloys and we expect that going into Q4 and Q1, we are, we expect that those orders will only go on increasing for us.

items.statement: Board recommended 3:1 bonus; process to complete by 11 April 2026 via securities premium account.
items.quote: we propose to issue three bonus shares of rupees ten, each fully paid up for every share that shareholders are holding.

items.statement: Metals business profitability focus starting to show in Q3; more expected in Q4 and Q1.
items.quote: So a little bit of that profitability focus has started coming through in the Q3 and we'll see more of that going into Q4 and Q1.

items.statement: New India-US and EU trade deals seen as tailwinds for exports to those markets.
items.quote: some of the new trade deals that India has made with US and EU, those will be further tailwinds for us because those are markets that are very keen to start working with us

items.statement: Climate control vertical currently loss-making; goal to keep losses minimal amid market conditions.
items.quote: The climate control business currently is loss making. So our goal in Q3 was to, you know, keep that damage under control, make sure that, you know, we, we keep that loss as small as possible

items.statement: Targeting consolidated revenue of ~Rs 600 crore in FY26, up from earlier Rs 550 crore estimate.
items.quote: Even though we've set 550 I think we would love to have that number as close to $600. As 600 this this year itself.

items.statement: Aiming to cross 10% EBITDA margin around Q4 FY26 or Q1 FY27 as pending price corrections (4-8%) flow through.
items.quote: I said directionally that we are aiming to cross 10 % on the EBITDA number, right. Somewhere between, yeah, somewhere around Q4 and perhaps going into Q1.

items.statement: Price corrections of 4-8% sought from long-pending OEM customers; partial flows received in Q3, more expected in Q4 and Q1.
items.period: Q3 FY26, Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27
items.quote: We've been asking them a certain figure. It could be anywhere between 4 to 8 % in terms of the correction that they need to make on the pricing, right.

items.statement: Automotive vertical capex of Rs 5-8 crore per year for next 3 years; no significant capex for brass mill.
items.quote: In the automotive vertical, we expect that the average CapEx per year would be somewhere in the range of five to eight cores. Right. That would be the kind of CapEx that we'll be looking at each year.

items.statement: US customer order traction improving after tariff clarity; positive developments with Lenux and other US/Taiwan customers.
items.quote: I do believe that, you know, we will see a lot of traction in the US market, be it Lenux or any other customer. We do see that, you know, the order positions, the order's already going up.

items.statement: Ather Energy uses Triton pressure relief valves in 100% of its vehicles on road today.
items.quote: There is not a single Ather vehicle on the road today without a Triton pressure relief valve in the battery pack.

items.statement: EV pressure relief valves priced at Rs 100-180 per piece depending on customization.
items.quote: These vents are sold at anywhere between, I would say, about, about about a hundred to I would say a hundred eighty rupees per piece.

items.statement: Heavy capex phase is over; no new capex needed until capacity is utilized.
items.quote: The heavy Capex phase, which we have been investing so far, is behind us now.

items.statement: Current footprint supports 1 million vehicles and 6 GWh cell capacity; revenue potential ₹15,000-20,000 crores.
items.quote: Our current footprint supports 1 million vehicles and 6 gigawatt hour of cell capacity and the focus now shifts to scaling into this capacity.

items.statement: Service backlogs reduced nearly 50% from 14 days to 7-8 days; 80% tickets same-day.
items.quote: service backlogs have reduced nearly 50% from 14 days to around 7-8 days now, and we are now completing 80% of service tickets on the same day.

items.statement: Quarterly OPEX including leases reduced to ₹484 crores; steady state expected ₹250-300 crores.
items.quote: Consolidated quarterly OPECs, including leases, reduced from ₹840 crores at peak expansion to ₹484 crores during this Q3 and we expect steady state between, give or take ₹250 to ₹300 crores over the next couple of quarters.

items.statement: EBITDA breakeven reduces to approximately 15,000 units per month with 85-90% fixed costs.
items.quote: At this level, our EBITDA breakeven reduces to approximately 15,000 units per month, with 85% or 90% of OPEX being fixed cost

items.statement: Service fix will take another quarter to fully institutionalize; brand trust recovery will take time.
items.quote: It will take us another quarter or so to fully institutionalize service.

items.statement: Volumes improved 2X-3X in markets where service challenges were more deeply solved.
items.quote: we see volumes have improved almost 2X-3X in some markets wherever we have more meaningfully solved service challenges.

items.statement: Cell technology roadmap: 4680 to 4600 to 46120 over next 12-24 months, improving energy density and fast charging.
items.quote: in the next 12 to 24 months, 4680 goes to 4600 goes to 46120. Each next generation of cell actually gets us more energy density and more fast charging performance.

items.statement: Gigafactory scaling from 2.5 GWh to 6 GWh installed capacity by March 2026.
items.quote: We are currently at 2.5 gigawatt hour install capacity, scaling to 6 gigawatt hour by March 2026.

items.statement: No further gigafactory expansion expected beyond current roadmap; PLI 20 GWh allocation under discussion with government.
items.quote: for our business priorities, we don't expect any more gigafactory expansion as far as the current roadmap goes.

items.statement: 6 GWh capacity yields ~5 GWh, sufficient for ~1.2 million products across auto and Shakti.
items.quote: 5 gigawatt hour, if each product takes 3.5-4 kilowatt hour, that's about 1.2 million products.

items.statement: Next leg of EV growth requires educating follower customers; company to take meaningful marketing steps soon.
items.quote: this next level of a customer, which is a follower customer, needs more education and marketing of that. And you'll see the company, you'll see us do some meaningful steps in that direction very soon.

items.statement: Full-year guidance remains firm and consistent despite US duty announcement.
items.quote: our guidance which we have given at the start of the year, reaffirmed in quarter three earning call, remains firm and consistent.

items.statement: US module capacity to expand from 2.6 GW to 4.2 GW by mid-calendar year.
items.quote: our estimation is that all the two capacities acquired as well as under construction should be operational by mid of this current calendar year.

items.statement: Order book grew from ~₹40,000 crore to ~₹60,000 crore, net of dispatches.
items.quote: When we started this year our order book was in the range of 40,000 crore s plus cumulative order book. As we as we did our last earning call, it was in the range of 60,000 crore.

items.statement: No margin impact expected from US duty; contracts allow cost pass-through if needed.
items.quote: we really don't foresee any impact on the margins as far as this duty announcement is concerned, because of the same reasons that we have supply chain available from the countries wherein the impact shall not come across at all.

items.statement: US module prices currently $0.30-0.31; order book secured at $0.35-0.38, providing headroom.
items.quote: currently the price is in the range of $0.30, $0.31. We have a great leg space even for the further price impact in the US which will not impact at all the economics for the developers.

items.statement: US annual module demand expected at 70-80 GW, with pipeline of 180-200 GW over 2-3 years.
items.quote: broadly this 70, 80 gigawatt of overall co nsumption every year leads to a demand outlook of 180 to 200 gigawatt over next two, three years of time in US.

items.statement: 70% of revenue from premium segments: retail, overseas, and EPC/O&M services.
items.quote: around 70% of our revenues are coming from these three markets which are high premium and market which have clear cut entry barrier.

items.statement: Ongoing investigation on Chinese cell usage; provision already made for potential financial impact.
items.quote: proactively basis the discussions and advice of our councils, we have already done provision in the last quarter itself on the potential financial impacts.

items.statement: Oman polysilicon facility at pilot stage; commercial production expected in 2-3 months.
items.quote: the factory is already at the pilot stage and pilot production is already ongoing. Commercial production generally takes two to three months of time for such kind of capacities.

items.statement: US manufacturing run rate to increase as new capacity ramps up.
items.quote: as the new capacity keep coming up, I think the manufacturing in US is bound to increase from the numbers that we have seen in the previous quarters.

items.statement: Overseas revenue to remain 30-35% of total, with export-heavy order book over 3-4 years.
items.quote: on a revenue conversion basis, the overall overseas revenue generally comes around 30% to 35%, which is the number this year you could see even the last year also the number was below 30%.

items.statement: Plans to add 300-400 customers in 2-3 years, reaching 500+ customer base.
items.quote: we have a plan of adding another 300, 400 customers in 2-3 years

items.statement: Expects significant revenue from US subsidiary in next financial year.
items.quote: in this financial… next financial year, we should have a significant revenue from there also.

items.statement: Won 95 Cr 5-year healthcare KPO contract in Asia Pacific.
items.quote: one of the largest deals which we did in Asia Pacific was a 95 Cr contract. This was, again, a healthcare service provider, a KPO, wherein we had a 5-year deal

items.statement: Healthcare vertical has 200-250 Cr worth of contracts from 2-3 customers.
items.quote: among these two, three customers, we have more than 200-250 CR worth of contract.

items.statement: International customers have better margins; international revenue share increased to 28% in 9M FY26 from 25% last year.
items.quote: Which is a good sign, because international customers have better margins.

items.statement: IP will provide recurring revenue and better margins and profitability.
items.quote: this IP will give us a very sustenance and average recurring revenue, and also better margins and profitability.

items.statement: Sees significant opportunity in AI-as-a-service and CX-as-a-service market, 15 billion+ and growing.
items.quote: So, we see a significant opportunity. It's a 15 billion+ market, which is going to grow year on year.

items.statement: Top 10 customers contribute 85-87% of revenue, indicating concentration risk.
items.quote: And top 10 customers has been contributing close to 85-87% of revenue.

items.statement: Plans to establish global NOC in Noida and customer experience center in Chennai.
items.quote: we plan to establish our global NOC here in Noida. This will be shared across the globe, so, my CTO, Gopi, has a vision, then how we can set up a bigger NOC in Noida, and we will have a customer experience center based out of Chennai.

items.statement: Expects 25-30% revenue growth and 50-60% PAT growth in Q4 FY26 vs Q4 FY25
items.quote: See, revenue growth, we are expecting around 25 -30%, and PAT would be in the range of 50-60%.

items.statement: Total order book Rs 348 Cr, healthcare segment contributes Rs 210-220 Cr including IKS Health Rs 130 Cr and BLS Rs 95 Cr
items.quote: Okay, so let me tell yo u that out of 348Cr order book which we are talking, around close to 220Cr is from healthcare. So, 210 to 220Cr would be from healthcare.

items.statement: Order book growing 30-40% YoY, expects much higher growth with international expansion
items.quote: See, order book is increasing 30-40% year-on-year. We see much more increase as we expand more in international geography.

items.statement: ARR grew from Rs 20 Cr (3 years ago) to Rs 60 Cr (last year), targeting Rs 100-110 Cr this year
items.quote: Just to give you a figure, our AR R, our annual recu rring revenue was close to 20 Cr, 3 years back. It increased to 60 Cr last year, and this year, we will be closing around 100, 110 Cr.

items.statement: IP launch accelerated to 6-7 months from 1 year, revenue expected from Q3 FY27
items.quote: Q3 onw ards, you can expect, Akshayji. So, with some of these AI tools, we have expedited the process, and with some partnership also.

items.statement: International revenue mix improved to 28% (9M FY26) from 25% (FY25), targeting significant revenue from US, UK, Singapore, Australia this year
items.quote: But if you see 9 months that this proposition has changed, when it's 72% domestic and 28% international, Which is a good sign, because international customers have better margins.

items.statement: Aims to acquire 500-600 customers in next 3 years via IP and partnerships, key partnerships to be announced soon for global revenue
items.quote: Our motto is very clear. We want to acquire 500- 600 customers in the next 3 years of time, and that may happen both through ou r IP, as well as adding more partnership.

items.statement: Healthcare order book includes 5-year contracts with top-up potential, AI expected to significantly expand addressable opportunities in patient data analytics
items.quote: Now, these healthcare customers, while we have 5 -year contract, there is a huge potential of other oppo rtunities also from the service provider.
